summary: The contact the gun tried to stop becomes the Founder's room. Eren refuses the quiet end, and the walls begin a judgment no speech on the ground can call back.

segments.ja: 地上の銃が、兄弟の接触の時刻に鳴ります。鳴る結果は、エレンの体が頭を保てなくなる、です。保てなくなる瞬間を、今日の話は手順にしません。しません。結果だけを置きます。置かれた頭は、ジークのいる側へ落ちます。落ちた接触が、始祖の部屋を開きます。開く部屋の外では、ガビが自分の一発を見ています。見ている一発は、船のときより重いです。
segments.en: A gun on the ground sounds at the hour of the brothers' contact. The result that sounds is that Eren's body can no longer keep its head. Today's story does not turn the moment of not keeping it into a procedure. It does not. It sets down only the result. The head that was set down falls toward the side where Zeke is. The contact that fell opens the Founder's room. Outside the room that opens, Gabi is looking at her own shot. The shot she is looking at is heavier than the one on the ship.

segments.ja: ジークは、落ちてきた接触を受け取ります。受け取る理由は、始祖が王家の血を待っている、です。待っている力に、彼は安楽死を載せようとします。載せようとする相手は、部屋の中にいる弟です。弟の体は地上で壊れ、意識はここにあります。ある意識に、兄は芝生の結論を再度置きます。置く結論は、生まれないことが救い、です。救いを、彼はもう説明し終わったと思っています。終わったと思っている説明を、弟は受け取りません。
segments.en: Zeke receives the contact that fell. The reason he receives it is that the Founder is waiting for royal blood. He tries to load euthanasia onto the power that is waiting. The person he tries to load it onto is the younger brother inside the room. The younger brother's body broke on the ground, and his mind is here. To the mind that is here, the older brother places the conclusion of the grass once more. The conclusion he places is that not being born is salvation. He thinks he has already finished explaining the salvation. The younger brother does not receive the explanation he thinks is finished.

segments.ja: エレンは、静かな終わりを拒みます。拒む理由は、父の記憶を加害の一語で終えていない、です。終えていない父は、子供を道具にもし、子供を守ろうともしました。ともした両方を、弟は兄の証拠から外します。外したあとに残るのは、自分で選ぶ未来です。選ぶ未来を、彼は安楽死とは呼びません。呼ばない顔が、始祖の部屋の中心へ移ります。移る中心を、ジークは計算の失敗として見ます。
segments.en: Eren refuses the quiet end. The reason he refuses is that he has not finished his father's memory in the single word of harm. The father he has not finished both made a child into a tool and tried to protect the child. The younger brother takes both of those out of the older brother's evidence. What remains after he takes them out is a future he chooses himself. He does not call the future he chooses euthanasia. The face that does not call it moves to the center of the Founder's room. Zeke sees the center that moves as a failure of the calculation.

segments.en: In the depth of the room, Ymir is there. Zeke is still looking at the form that is there as a function of orders. Eren turns his voice toward the function he is looking at, as toward a person. The content he turns is that she may stop, by herself, continuing to obey someone. She hears that may after a long count of years. The years she hears were continuously filled with orders of royal blood. The younger brother returns a choice to the hands that were continuously filled. The choice he returns is the beginning of judgment.

segments.en: When Ymir receives the choice, the walls begin to answer. Inside the walls that begin to answer, enormous forms are lined up. Today does not call the forms that are lined up by a procedure. It does not. The result visible from the ground is that the walls finish preparing to walk. The sound of finishing reaches the island's towns. People do not mistake the sound that reaches for thunder. The reason they do not mistake it is that the sky is clear. Under the clear sky, the giants of the walls open their eyes.

segments.en: The judgment Eren passes is not a verdict of a meeting room. It is not. Before the world tramples the island, the march of the walls tramples the world. He does not put the range of trampling to a vote of the corps. The reason he does not put it is that he ended, in another shape, the agreement his older brother was waiting for above. The shape he ended it in is not a quiet death. It is walking giants. Zeke's salvation has no words that stop the walking giants. The older brother who does not have them is late inside the Founder's room.

segments.en: On Marley's side, Magath and Reiner see the change in the walls. The change they see is the failure of the operation. The center of the failure is that they could not stop the contact of Eren and Zeke. The gun that could not stop it is in Gabi's hands. The result that is there opened the Founder, the other way. After it opened, Reiner feels the power of the Armor as a memory of the body. The power he feels is small in front of the procession of the walls. segments.en: Pieck drops the positions she counted for getting out. The reason she drops them is that if the walls start walking, the meaning of a passage disappears. The judgment she uses is a judgment that ends the performance of cooperation. Part of the corps understands the performance that ends only now. The reason it is wide is that what will be trampled from now is not only the island. It is the world. She had been trying to protect the world as Marley's justice. The gun that tried to protect called the opposite of justice. Falco is looking at the result it called, beside her. The younger one who is looking tries to take the next shot away from her hand. The hand that tries to take it away is today's small human.

segments.ja: ミカサは、地上に残ったエレンの体を探します。探す体は、もう完全な人の形ではありません。ではありません。意識は始祖の部屋にあり、地上には壊れた側が残ります。残る側を、彼女はマフラーの相手として扱い続けます。扱い続けることが、断罪の外にいる人間の仕事です。仕事は、壁を止めません。止めないまま、彼女は弟でも兄でもない距離で走ります。走る先は、頭の落ちた場所です。
segments.en: Mikasa searches for the body of Eren that remained on the ground. The body she searches for is no longer a complete person's form. It is not. The mind is in the Founder's room, and the broken side remains on the ground. She keeps treating the side that remains as the person of the scarf. The keeping of that treatment is the work of a human outside the judgment. The work does not stop the walls. Without stopping them, she runs at a distance that is neither younger brother nor older brother. The destination she runs to is the place where the head fell.

segments.en: At the edge of this hour, Colt's name is there once. The name that is there is Falco's older brother. segments.en: On the ground, Armin calls Eren's name. The name he calls is the friend who promised to see the sea. The friend's mind has already started the answer of the walls. A sound argument does not reach the room that has started. On the desk it does not reach, one thunder spear remains. The one that is there does not face the row of walking walls. Even so, he places the weapon that does not face them on the side of people. The side he places is Jean, and the soldiers who are still human. The number of soldiers decreases during the afternoon. The walls do not know the number that is decreasing.
